posts.cooked:
So I feel like the Colosseum is totally disgusting for Haka to play in. I got both of these cards pretty early on and she had 4 gladiators out each time. So it was 5 damage done 5 times (and one more for an environment target) and dealing multiple targets more than 2 in a single turn for 7 favor off a single card and then I gained the title that is shown off using that card. Then I did it again 2 turns later. Am I wrong or is this just busted?

I've gained 4 titles with a Rampage, which I think is the most you can earn.  The Seeker, Champion, The Indiscriminate, and since I earned indiscriminate before hitting myself, Reckless.

 

Trust me When Haka dives in and crushes everything the crowd tends to notice.  He's the most obvious gladiator in the game, and he owns the arena.
